profile.headline: ML Infra / Platform @ Tesla ML Team | CMU | Full-Stack Engineer
profile.summary:
• Experienced in Full-Stack development: Strong with both front-end and back-end development, specializing in large-scale distributed systems, cloud computing, and machine learning platforms.

• Skilled in creating robust systems that handle millions of daily requests with low latency, leveraging cloud services (AWS, GCP, Azure), and designing solutions that enhance scalability and efficiency.

• Developed Machine Learning platforms supporting 80+ models, and implemented LLM Agent Platforms with RAG strategies to reduce latency and minimize hallucination rates for enhanced reliability.

• Proven ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams, streamlining processes and improving system scalability and performance across different departments.

◆𝗦𝗸𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗦𝗲𝘁:

• Programming: JavaScript, Typescript, Python, Objective C, Swift
• Frameworks: React, React Native, Node.js, jQuery
• Cloud Services: GCP, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Apache Kafka, Spark, Nginx, Airflow
• Databases: MySQL, NoSQL, Raft, Redis, Mongo DB, Distributed Systems
• LLM: llama.cpp, RAG, transformers, Hugging Face, langchain
• Tools / Methods: gRPC, Webpack, Docker, Jest, React Testing Library, Scrum, Agile

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an ML platform with a robust API server, front-end, and distributed database, handling 7M+ daily requests with 250ms response time and accelerating 80+ ML models integrated into Tesla Applications.

• Created an LLM Agent Platform using RAG strategy and vector database, achieving a 50% reduction of latency and decreasing the hallucination rate to enhance performance and reliability.

• Led the restructuring and containerization of the data pipeline to enhance scalability, enabling faster integration of additional ML models and simplifying the development process.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working in the Machine Learning Team (2023 May - 2023 Aug)

• Designed a platform from scratch, enabling Data Scientists to build visual web apps without any front-end knowledge, resulting in reducing their web development timelines from weeks to just a few days.

• Developed and integrated a robust ML ETL pipeline, streamlining development cycles and ensuring seamless, automated updates for machine learning models.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Skywatch is a platform that provides streaming service, messaging service and API for users to access IP cameras and IoT (Internet of Things) sensors easily and efficiently. I'm involving in the re-architecture of front-end platform, maintaining existing IoT SDK, integrating React Native into existing iOS / Android products and developing a next-generation API library.

• Led web platform team to distribute large web service (JS, PHP, Python, Node.js) into several modules, helping junior engineers easy to develop new features with decoupled dependencies and modularized legacy code.

• Led APP and front-end team to reconstruct an interface between an iOS app, C++ SDK, and React Native, increasing the scalability and shrinking fat JS bundle files 5 times to speed up 30% performance.

• Created JavaScript SDK from scratch to support vendors to develop their IoT Services. (number of devices: 50,000+)
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Computing · Apache Kafka · Kubernetes · Web Development · iOS Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · React.js · React Native · Node.js · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Inventec is one of the world's largest original equipment manufacturers of notebook computers, servers, mobile phones, and appliances. My position is a full-stack engineer in the department of AI ​​Center. 

• Responsible for iOS / React Native / Web product

• Designed and implemented a IoT management system (RESTful API server with OAuth 2.0) from scratch to help vendors analyze near real-time data coming from IoT devices.

• Developed Chatbot service based on Node.js, Docker and Kubernetes into IoT platform to support customers control IoT devices easily and efficiently.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Databases · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Web Development · iOS Development · Python (Programming Language) · React.js · React Native · Node.js · PHP

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tico is a software company that focuses on creating secure and human-centered communication solutions to improve collaborations for the world.

• Responsible for iOS / Android / React Native / Web APP

• Developed communication service from scratch based on React Native, with 10,000+ users.

• Built testing environment to improve front-end developing quality using Jest and React Testing Library.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · iOS Development · Android Development · React Native

positions.title: iOS Summer Instructor
positions.description:
Received the company's full subsidy to SF training, and became a lecturer at the first summer program school in Taipei.

• Taught students aged 12-35 with no programming experience to build and demo their own iOS apps using Swift.
